# cato_dns_forwarding_rule (Resource)

Manages one standalone DNS forwarding rule via networkConfig.dns. Unrelated collection items remain unchanged. Requires NCS_DNS_PUBLIC_API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_dns_forwarding_rule" "example" {
  domain = "example.test"
  server = ["192.0.2.53", "192.0.2.54"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Unique DNS forwarding domain.
- `server` (List of String) Ordered forwarding server addresses (1–6).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Collection item IDs are opaque and must be preserved unchanged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cato_dns_forwarding_rule.example OPAQUE_RESOURCE_ID
```
